parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: If he takes even one more ____ towards us, arrest him.
My girlfriend and I have very similar ____ in music; we both love rock.
I’m so sorry you had to go ____ an experience like that. Are you ok now?

I wanted to get a car but didn’t buy anything ____ the end. I don’t really need one.
Bob hates the food here in Spain, and he doesn’t like the weather ____ .
What do you mean you’re not looking forward ____ your wedding?!
I’m afraid I can’t talk to you right ____ . Can I call you back in five minutes?
I’m not sure that hotel was ____ the money we paid. And the manager was useless!

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: Did you use to get nervous at school when teachers asked you to read out loudly in front of the rest of the class?
The shop made me an offer of £650 for my guitar, which I accepted because it was much too low. I decided not to sell the instrument.
You can confess everything to us now if you want, but you also have the right to ask a lawer for advice first. It’s your decision.
That pullover’s never going to keep you warmly on the farm all day; you’ll need a jacket too, won’t you?
I’m going to marry Lisa; who is, if she says yes!
A strong coffee each morning is fine, but it is not wise by drinking it throughout the day as if it were water.
We’d better inform the police about the gun we found in the garden, wouldn’t we?
I commanded the men they should enter the building.
Is it true that eating oranges helps to guard from colds?

parts.text: The three forms of “lead” are “lead, led, led”. The three forms of “sink” are “sink, sank, sunk”. The three forms of “lay” are “lay, laid, laid”. The three forms of “steal” are “steal, stole, stolen”. The United Kingdom includes England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. The five senses are sight, hearing, taste, touch and smell. The word “unless” means “except if”. The only safe time to walk along this beach is at low tide. If you want to go abroad, you’ll probably need your passport. Derek took the bill from the waiter and paid it immediately. Cats have a better sense of hearing than dogs. There’s steam coming out of the kettle.

2: The shop made me an offer of £650 for my guitar, which I rejected because it was much too low. I decided not to sell the instrument.
3: You can confess everything to us now if you want, but you also have the right to ask a lawyer for advice first. It’s your decision.
4: That pullover’s never going to keep you warm on the farm all day; you’ll need a jacket too, won’t you?
5: I’m going to marry Lisa; that is, if she says yes!
6: A strong coffee each morning is fine, but it is not wise to drink it throughout the day as if it were water.
7: We’d better inform the police about the gun we found in the garden, hadn’t we?
8: I commanded the men to enter the building.
